name: use-case-page
title: Use case page
description: A use case's page as the site sets it: the hero with the connect menu and the chat answering beside it, the proof line over the marks, the scroll story, three stories, the wheel of audiences with the light around its ring, the FAQ, the closing section and the footer.

'use client' import { SiteHeader } from '@/components/site/SiteHeader' import { AsciiTrail } from '@/components/visuals/AsciiTrail' import { UseCaseHero } from '@/components/site/UseCaseHero' import { ConnectMenu } from '@/components/site/ConnectMenu' import { ProofBlock } from '@/components/site/ProofBlock' import { ScrollStory } from '@/components/blocks/ScrollStory' import { StoriesBlock } from '@/components/blocks/StoriesBlock' import { UseCaseWheel } from '@/components/blocks/UseCaseWheel' import { FaqBlock } from '@/components/blocks/FaqBlock' import { PageClose } from '@/components/site/PageClose' import { SiteFooter } from '@/components/blocks/SiteFooter' import { DispersionField } from '@/components/visuals/DispersionField' import type { ChatContent, BuildContent } from '@/lib/use-case-hero' import { useCaseContent, type UseCaseContent, useCaseSections, type UseCaseSection, type UseCaseBlocks } from '@/lib/pages/use-case' import { cn } from '@/lib/cn' import { pageSections } from '@/lib/image' import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react' import type { HeaderMenus } from '@/lib/site-header' // A use case's page as the site sets it (app/use-cases/[slug], pages/UseCasesPage/UseCaseDetail): the header, the // hero (the name, the line, the connect menu with a quiet button and the chat answering beside them, or the build // visual), the proof line over the marquee of marks, the scroll story with its two buttons, the stories in three cards // (Acme's, with initials), the wheel of audiences with the light around its ring, the FAQ with the docs button, the // closing section and the footer. `content` replaces the copy (lib/pages/use-case.ts); `visual`, `chat` and `build` go // to the hero; `still` holds the wheel and its light (for a still preview). export interface UseCasePageProps { content?: UseCaseContent visual?: 'chat' | 'build' chat?: ChatContent build?: BuildContent /** Hold the wheel and its light still. */ still?: boolean /** Each block's data, pictures included: the story's `story` and the wheel's `items`. */ blocks?: UseCaseBlocks /** The header menus' content, pictures included (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`); Acme by default. */ menus?: HeaderMenus /** The sections to show, in order; all of them in the page order by default (leave one out to omit it). */ sections?: readonly UseCaseSection[] className?: string } const CONTAINER = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-[calc(var(--ds-layout-content)+2*var(--ds-layout-gutter))] px-(--ds-layout-gutter)' export function UseCasePage({ content: c = useCaseContent, visual = 'chat', chat, build, still = false, blocks = {}, menus, sections, className }: UseCasePageProps) { const parts: Record = { hero: : undefined} />, proof: , story: , stories: , wheel: } />, faq: (
), close: , } return (
{pageSections(useCaseSections, sections).map((k) => {parts[k]})}
) } export default UseCasePage
